name: cancel_appointment
description: Use after the caller clearly confirms cancellation. Reuse caller_full_name already established in this conversation; never ask for it again. Include the real appointment_id from list_appointments whenever available. If omitted, the backend proceeds only when that exact patient has one upcoming appointment; multiple appointments require explicit selection. Never invent an ID. Mention a fee only when cancellation_fee.applicable is true.

appointment_id.description: Exact appointments[].appointment_id UUID. Required when multiple upcoming appointments exist; omit only when exactly one exists.
